units.source_text: 薰中纳言在谈话之中提起二女公子所说的那个可以代替大女公子的人。

en.t: During the conversation, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, brought up the person the Second Princess had said could stand in for the Elder Princess.

units.source_text: 弁君答道：“此人现在是否在京，我不知道。

en.t: Ben no Kimi answered, "I do not know whether that person is now in the capital.

units.source_text: 关于她的情况，我都是听人传说的：已故八亲王尚未迁居山庄之前，夫人病故。

en.t: As for her circumstances, I have only heard them from others: before the late Eighth Prince moved to the mountain villa, his wife died of illness.

units.source_text: 不久，亲王和一个上等侍女私通。

en.t: Soon afterward, the prince secretly had relations with a high-ranking gentlewoman attendant.

units.source_text: 这侍女名叫中将君，品貌还不坏。

en.t: This attendant was called Chujo no Kimi, and her character and looks were not bad at all.

units.source_text: 但亲王和她交往时间甚短，别人都不知道。

en.t: But the prince was with her for only a very short time, and no one else knew about it.

units.source_text: 后来这中将君生了一个女儿。

en.t: Later, this Chujo no Kimi gave birth to a daughter.

units.source_text: 亲王原知此女儿是自己所生，但因嫌其烦累，此后不再和她交往。

en.t: The prince knew from the start that this daughter was his own child, but because he thought the matter would be troublesome, he no longer visited her after that.

units.source_text: 又为此事痛自惩诫，就此皈依佛法，度送僧侣一般的生涯。

en.t: Deeply reproaching himself for the affair, he turned to the Buddhist law and lived a life like that of a monk.

units.source_text: 中将君失去依靠，只得辞职，后来嫁与一个陆奥守为妻，跟着他赴陆奥任地去了。

en.t: Chujo no Kimi lost her support and had no choice but to leave service; later she married a Governor of Mutsu and followed him to his post in Mutsu.

units.source_text: 过了几年，中将君返京，辗转央人向亲王示意：女儿抚养在家，平安无恙。

en.t: After several years, Chujo no Kimi returned to the capital and, through intermediaries, let the prince know that the daughter was being raised at home and was safe and well.

units.source_text: 亲王听到了，说道：‘此事不须向我通报。’表示不肯收留。

en.t: When the prince heard this, he said, 'There is no need to report this matter to me,' showing that he refused to take her in.

units.source_text: 中将君不胜懊丧。

en.t: Chujo no Kimi was terribly disheartened.

units.source_text: 后来她丈夫当了常陆介，又带了她赴任地去。

en.t: Later her husband became Assistant Governor of Hitachi, and again took her with him to his post.

units.source_text: 此后久无音信。

en.t: After that, there was no word from them for a long time.

units.source_text: 今年春天这位小姐到匂亲王府访问二小姐之事，我亦略有所闻。

en.t: I have also heard a little about how this young lady visited the Second Princess at Prince Niou's residence this spring.

units.source_text: 这位小姐今年大约二十岁。

en.t: This young lady is about twenty years old this year.

units.source_text: 前些时她母亲曾有来信，说‘小姐长得非常美丽，十分可怜’，信中叙述甚详呢。”

en.t: Some time ago her mother sent a letter saying, 'The young lady has grown extremely beautiful and very dear,' and the letter described her in great detail."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听了她的详细说明，想道：“如此看来，二女公子说她酷肖其姐，多半是真的了。”

en.t: After hearing her detailed explanation, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought, "In that case, what the Second Princess said about her looking very much like her elder sister is probably true."

units.source_text: 他盼望一见，便吩咐弁君：“只要其人略有几分肖似大小姐，即使住在他乡异国，我也要去寻找。

en.t: Longing to see her once, he instructed Ben no Kimi, "If she resembles the Elder Princess even a little, I will go searching for her even if she lives in some distant land.

units.source_text: 八亲王虽然不认她为女儿，但毕竟是血统很近的人。

en.t: Although the Eighth Prince did not acknowledge her as his daughter, she is still, after all, someone very close in blood.

units.source_text: 你也不必特地去通知，只要在音问往还之时，乘便把我的意思告诉她。”

en.t: You need not go out of your way to notify her; just convey my wishes when letters happen to pass back and forth."

units.source_text: 弁君说：“她的母亲中将君是已故亲王夫人的侄女，和我是姑表姐妹关系。

en.t: Ben no Kimi said, "Her mother, Chujo no Kimi, was a niece of the late prince's wife, and she and I are cousins on the paternal-aunt side.

units.source_text: 中将君在亲王家供职时，我住在外地，所以和她不甚熟悉。

en.t: When Chujo no Kimi served in the prince's household, I was living elsewhere, so I was not very familiar with her.

units.source_text: 前些时二小姐的侍女大辅君从京中来信，说这位小姐希望到亲王坟上祭扫，叫我有所准备。

en.t: Some time ago, the Second Princess's attendant, Taifu no Kimi, wrote from the capital saying that this young lady wished to visit the prince's grave and asking me to make preparations.

units.source_text: 但至今还不曾到这里来过。

en.t: But so far she has not come here.

units.source_text: 既蒙吩咐，等她来时我定当将尊意转达。”

en.t: Since you have instructed me, I will certainly convey your wishes when she comes."

units.source_text: 夜色已近黎明，薰中纳言准备回京。

en.t: The night was already nearing dawn, and Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, prepared to return to the capital.

units.source_text: 他就把昨夜黄昏后京中送来的绢帛等物赠送阿阇梨，又赏赐弁君。

en.t: He gave the silk and other items that had arrived from the capital after dusk the previous night to the Ajari, and also bestowed gifts on Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨寺中诸法师及弁君的仆役，也都受赐布匹等物。

en.t: The monks in the Ajari's temple and Ben no Kimi's servants all received cloth and other gifts as well.

units.source_text: 这住处实甚荒寂，但因薰中纳言常常来访，多方照拂，故以弁君的身份而论，生涯过得十分安乐，她可以从容自在地修行佛法。

en.t: The dwelling was truly desolate and lonely, but because Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, often visited and cared for her in many ways, Ben no Kimi lived very comfortably for someone of her station and could practice the Buddhist path calmly and at ease.
